name: Tiling Compositing
definition: A parallel compositing strategy for distributed volume rendering where processing elements (PEs) hold tiles of the final image and pass partial results to adjacent PEs in a staggered, linear fashion to merge them into the final image.
summary: Tiling Compositing is a parallel volume rendering strategy where processing elements pass and merge image tiles in a staggered linear fashion, keeping all processors active unlike the inverted binary tree method.
